svg.title: Formkey: Storefront for artisan keycaps: catalog, bag, checkout, a PayPal payment simulator and an admin for orders.
svg.desc: Project card for Formkey, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts. Storefront for artisan keycaps: catalog, bag, checkout, a PayPal payment simulator and an admin for orders. Built with React, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Playwright.
